case.summary: This investigation was triggered by customer C09988 reporting an unauthorized $59.67 online purchase (transaction 3534820) which exhibited a moderately elevated risk score of 0.37. Evidence reviewed included the customer's profile history, transaction pattern, and similar confirmed fraud cases from case memory. Because the customer explicitly denied the transaction, policy R2 applies directly without needing further verification steps. Consequently, the recommended actions are to block the card (`BLOCK_CARD`) and create a formal case file (`CREATE_CASE`).

stop_reason: Fraud probability was extreme enough on initial evidence to act without further verification.
